newsitem.title: UK: UK grain futures up on lack of farmer selling.
newsitem.headline: UK grain futures up on lack of farmer selling.

text.p: A lack of farmer selling pushed a volatile LIFFE grains market up on Wednesday, with moves accentuated by thin volume, traders said.

Total volume on wheat was just 343 lots. May was most active, with 133 lots done. It last traded up 0.90 stg at 95.90 stg. March moved between a low of 92.80 stg and a high of 93.90 stg during the day.
Just six lots of barley changed hands, all on March, which last traded 0.50 stg up at 93.30 stg.
Currency remains the main tone-setting feature of the market, they said.
But tight supply injected a feeling of urgency, which exaggerated the market's movements, they said.
